psychological_meaning: Granite Green evokes feelings of stability, resilience, and groundedness. It suggests a connection to nature and the earth, promoting a sense of calm and dependability. This color often represents practicality and understated elegance, making it suitable for designs that require a touch of sophistication and reliability.

real_world_examples.title: Granite Countertops
real_world_examples.description: Granite Green is often seen in kitchen countertops, adding a touch of natural elegance.

real_world_examples.title: Military Apparel
real_world_examples.description: The color is often used in military uniforms and apparel, signifying strength and resilience.

how_to_pair: Pair with creams and off-whites for a soft, natural look.
Combine with browns and tans for an earthy palette.
Use with metallic accents for a touch of sophistication.
